boundaryProof.historicalClaimsPolicy: The assigned current documentation was read in full. Historical audit/test claims in that document were not used as truth and their references were not followed.

limitations: This is a complete static semantic audit of the assigned Web partition, not browser interaction or test execution. No claim is made that any suite passed or that all dynamic behavior is proven correct.

Current Web request construction, response checks, imported protocol usage and local types were reviewed. Full server-side protocol implementation and deployment behavior are outside this partition and require the other independent reviewers.
No concrete suspected defect required an isolated offline probe. Zero findings means no actionable defect was established by this review, not a proof that defects cannot exist.
conclusion: Complete independent Web partition review on the unchanged frozen source; no actionable findings established.
methodDetails: Read AGENTS.md and the assigned inventory before semantic review. The startedAt timestamp records the completed initial independent raw-hash checkpoint immediately preceding partition reading.

Independently computed raw SHA-256 for all 1911 inventory entries at both checkpoints using Get-FileHash; independently executed the required snapshot script with the fixed Node runtime at both checkpoints. No mismatch or source digest change occurred.

Read all 202 assigned files completely, in manageable full-file or contiguous line-range outputs. Re-read missing ranges whenever tool output was truncated; the failed context-overflow attempt to read extensions and sharing diagnostics was discarded and both files were read again completely. Coverage was admitted only after complete semantic reading.

Traced API durable admission, receipt reconciliation, exact submitted draft snapshots, storage failures, login/session/connection generations, same-epoch reconnect readiness, repeated identity transitions, and stale asynchronous completion ownership.

Traced navigation and handoff, composer and attachment ownership, queue/goal/branch/review mutations, workspace file edits and version readback, Git previews/consent, worktree and recovery controls, terminal/process lifecycle, realtime media and sequence ownership, and explicit continuation boundaries.

Reviewed provider/configuration forms, credential clearing, current model capability confirmation, account handoffs, remote pairing, MCP discovery/calls/results/streams/OAuth, retained draft visibility, automation forms, extension/skill/plugin sharing, imports, diagnostics, user-input approvals, safe media/Markdown rendering, bounded display and accessible focus/modal behavior.
Read all 73 tests and fixtures to examine modeled inputs, timing, protocol shapes and assertion boundaries; did not treat existing test names or assertions as execution evidence.

Cross-checked a tentative DiagnosticsPanel download ownership concern against the actual ExtensionsPanel keys and lifecycle. The component is remounted across the relevant identity changes, so the concern was ruled out and is not reported as a finding.
